brief:
Cluster: the AFortPawn death path. Findings already established (verify, then build on them):
- AFortPawn declares two native C++ virtuals with no reflected names: vtable +0xa78 = 0x142310ce0 and +0xa80 = 0x142310c30 (inherited by AFortAIPawn/AFortPlayerPawn; AFortPlayerPawnAthena overrides them at 0x141a0fe40 / 0x141a0fe30). +0xa80 (FGameplayTag by value, AController*, AActor*) builds a one-tag container and forwards to +0xa78 (FGameplayTagContainer by value, AController*, AActor*). Proposed names KillWithDeathTag / KillWithDeathTags in work/dependencies/pawn-kill-virtuals (see /opt/fortnite/FortniteClient-12.60-CL-13477524/porting/server_scope/local_model/dependencies/pawn-kill-virtuals.proposal.json).
- +0xa78 body 0x142310ce0: if Role==Authority && !bIsDying { ASC = interface(this+0x4c8)->GetAbilitySystemComponent(); FGameplayEffectContextHandle ctx = ASC->MakeEffectContext() (ASC vtable +0x5d8); ctx.Get() byte at +0x70 = 1; context->AddInstigator(controller, actor) (vtable +0x10); build an FGameplayEffectSpec(effect from singleton 0x140774520 + 0x130, ctx, -1.0f); call this->vtable[0xa40](0.0f, tags, &spec, <local>, controller, actor); then unless the tags contain native tag +0x440, +0x430 or +0x448: notify the member object at this+0xb78 via 0x141bc3b40(obj, actor, this, 0), then ASC->ExecuteGameplayCue(tag at native +0x268, ctx) (0x1406c4b60) }. The container parameter is destroyed by the callee. +0xa40 target 0x14232b900 (32 lines) calls 0x142356e20, GetWorld, 0x1420b7ab0/0x1420c3cb0 and then vtable +0xa58 (see virtual_slots.py). Native tags: FFortNativeGameplayTagsRuntime::Get().GetTagAtOriginalOffset(off); +0x440 is Gameplay.Effect.InstantDeath.Silent.
- ForceKillNoDBNO body is already proposed in work/claude-1 and depends on KillWithDeathTag; ForceKill (0x1423178a0, UFUNCTION ForceKill(FGameplayTag DeathReason, AController* KillerController, AActor* KillerActor)) builds a one-tag container (empty tag -> native +0x410), clears LastHitBy when a controller is supplied, and calls +0xa78.
Goal: recover the +0xa78 / +0xa40 / +0xa58 chain and the helpers they need as real declarations and bodies, then finalize ForceKill, ForceKillNoDBNO and AFortAIPawn::ReviveFromDBNO (terra-1 evidence: member +0xbb8 is the ASC; tags NPC.Ability.NonAttack.DBNO and Event.Resurrected).
